The same projection also guards native replay. Only matching root identities are changed; v1-only raw names and unrelated domains/paths remain intact. The existing actor now has one strict FD reader: only actual POSIX ENOENT is absent, while ENOTDIR and non-regular/symlink paths are typed STATE_IO. It checks the regular-file size against 16MiB before allocation, reads that bounded descriptor with EINTR/cancellation handling, compares descriptor identity/size/mtime/ctime, and checks close before decoding/publishing. Failed reads preserve existing file bytes and cannot authorize an empty request header.
